recalculation.notes: Fortes combines literature series measured or reduced on heterogeneous mechanical, shock, ruby, NaCl, Au, and alpha-Fe scales but does not state a common recalculation path. Row-wise calibrant observations are not deposited, so the pressures cannot be normalized independently.

pressure_calibration.notes: Named methods are preserved only where the cited primary sources or Fortes Figure 4 identify them; no single calibration is assigned to the compiled fit.

assessment.basis: The published pressure surface is executable and three exact Kuznetsov fcc transition P-V-T anchors are bundled, but the compiled coefficient fit cannot be independently reproduced. The full 295-788 K Kuznetsov table was supplied privately to Fortes, while the exhaustive source-row selection, pressure-scale treatment, residual coordinate, weights, and covariance procedure are not published. See the [dedicated Fortes audit](literature-reproductions/fortes-2019-fcc-pb.md).

primary_source_check.finding: The stored BM4 record is exactly the 300 K isotherm of the fully specified polynomial P-V-T surface. The report's Table 1 constants are evaluated at Delta T=0 (300 K), not at absolute zero.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Equations 1-8; sections 2.1-2.3; Tables 1-2, report pages 8-9.
parameter_provenance.equation: Fortes (2019), Equations 1-5: fourth-order Eulerian finite-strain pressure with polynomial V0(T), K0(T), and K0_prime(T).
parameter_provenance.reference_state: Table 1's polynomial constant terms correspond to Delta T=T-300 K=0 and therefore to 300 K, not absolute zero.
parameter_provenance.V0: Table 1 V0(300 K)=121.418(5) A^3 per four-atom fcc conventional cell; fixed in the compression-stage fit after the thermal-expansion stage.
parameter_provenance.K0: Table 1 K0(300 K)=41.73(1) GPa; fixed in the compression-stage fit after conversion of literature adiabatic elastic moduli with Equation 8.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Table 1 K0_prime(300 K)=5.39(25), varied in the compression-stage fit together with its temperature slope e=0.0011(1) K^-1.
parameter_provenance.K0_double_prime: Table 1 K0_double_prime=-0.33(2) GPa^-1, assumed temperature invariant and varied in the compression-stage fit.

assessment.basis: The three bundled Table 1 rows are rounded fcc states at the phase transition, not the complete P-V-T observations used to fit the source's nine-coefficient thermal BM3 surface. The full numerical dataset, row selection, residual coordinate, weights, and covariance procedure are not published. See the [dedicated Fortes/Kuznetsov audit](literature-reproductions/fortes-2019-fcc-pb.md).

primary_source_check.finding: The stored BM3 record is exactly the 296 K isotherm of the published fcc P-V-T surface. The paper observes fcc Pb at room temperature, reports transition onset near 12 GPa, and tabulates a 296 K fcc transition state at 13.1 GPa.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Equations 1-3; Table 1; Table 2; Figures 2-3.
